historicalTranslation.noSources: No posted equity source is available.
historicalTranslation.loadFailed: Could not load the historical assessment.
historicalTranslation.instructions: Document the source measurement currency and genuine historical rate. Layers must exactly total the signed source amount. Proposals require the native Accounting event review before application.
historicalTranslation.existingPair: This presentation currency already has an applied certificate. Review its retained evidence; corrections require a governed source reversal.
historicalTranslation.identityHint: Same-currency documentary proof requires an explicit rate of exactly 1 and retained evidence.
historicalTranslation.openingHint: Record each genuine opening layer separately. Do not replace historical layers with a blended or current rate.
historicalTranslation.correctionHint: Select the applied parent layer, including a previous correction. Its exact rate, date and retained source remain fixed; supply the opposite signed correction amount.
historicalTranslation.proposalFailed: Could not create the historical proposal.
historicalTranslation.applyFailed: Could not apply the approved historical assessment.
historicalTranslation.reviewHint: Submit and review this proposal through the Accounting event workflow, then return here to apply the approved assessment.
historicalTranslation.sourceFailed: Could not read the retained Cabinet versions.
historicalTranslation.noHashedVersion: No version with a retained content hash is available. Choose a Cabinet source with verified bytes.

list.title: Journal
list.description: {count, plural, one {# posted entry} other {# posted entries}} · audited; closed periods are immutable.
list.noAvailableSubsidiary: Your role has no active subsidiary available for creating a journal. Ask an administrator for subsidiary access.

newButton.label: New journal
newButton.createFailed: Could not create a draft journal

drawer.draftDescription: Draft — changes save automatically. Debits and credits must balance to post.
drawer.deleteDraftBody: This permanently deletes the draft journal. This cannot be undone.
drawer.deletePostedBody: This permanently deletes the journal and removes its ledger impact. This cannot be undone.
drawer.voidStaleRevision: This journal changed after you opened it — the latest version is loaded. Review it and void again.
drawer.voidRevisionUnavailable: The journal could not be reloaded to void it. Close and reopen the journal, then void again.
drawer.referenceNumberHint: External number for this entry — the source document or statement reference. Shown beside the entry number.
drawer.memoHint: Internal narration stored on the entry. Shown on the journal list and audit trail.
drawer.partylessControlWarning: Posted with no party on {accounts}. These balances sit outside any customer or vendor subledger — see the aging (no party) row. Record customer receipts with Receive payment and supplier payments with Pay bills, or name the customer or vendor on the line. Setup → Company & Accounting → Control accounts can refuse these postings.
drawer.budgetaryControlWarning: Budget {scenario} is over appropriation for {account}, fund {fund}, {subsidiary}{dimensions}: available {available}, over by {amountOver}.
drawer.budgetaryControlRemedy: Revise the budget through its approval flow: copy the approved budget to a draft, raise this account's amount for the fund in the worksheet, approve the copy and archive the superseded budget. Or link this actual to the open encumbrance that reserved it.
drawer.voidAwaitingApproval: A void of this journal is awaiting approval. The journal stays posted until the approval is decided.
drawer.createUnconfirmed: The server did not confirm the new journal. Save again: the retry reuses this draft's key, so it cannot create a second journal.

instructions.serverBalance: Amounts in different currencies are balanced by their header-currency equivalents when saved.

drawer.invalidAmounts: An amount is not a valid number. Correct the highlighted amount, then save again.
drawer.postedAndNew: Posted to the ledger. A new journal is ready on the same date.
drawer.submitted: Submitted for approval instead of posted: an approval flow governs this journal.
drawer.submittedAndNew: Submitted for approval instead of posted: an approval flow governs this journal. A new journal is ready on the same date.
drawer.savedNotPosted: The journal was saved as a draft but not posted. Resolve the reason shown, then post the draft.
drawer.statisticalIncomplete: Every statistical line needs an account, a unit and a non-zero quantity before the journal can post.
drawer.postNeedsAmounts: Enter the debit and credit amounts before posting.
drawer.balanceLineHint: Put the remaining difference on the line you last worked in

book.label: Accounting book
book.allBooksHint: Posts to the primary book and replicates into every full book.
book.specificHint: Book-specific: posts to this book only, in the currency it keeps for the journal’s subsidiary.
